title: Product search and catalogue on the shop and the public product API

sourcesRead.contributes: user story, context (Products page, API endpoints, out of scope), Gherkin AC-1..AC-11, PO clarification replacing AC-4

actors: partner app using the public product API
context: The Products page (/products) shows the whole catalogue under "All Products" and has a search box ("Search Product") with a search button. The public product API on the same host takes form-encoded requests: GET /api/productsList (whole catalogue) and POST /api/searchProduct with the parameter search_product (matching products).

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-1 Catalogue is available through the API When a client calls GET /api/productsList Then the response lists the products of the catalogue in a "products" array And every product has an "id", a "name", a "price", a "brand" and a "category" And the category holds the audience ("usertype", e.g. Women, Men, Kids) and the category name And every price is written as "Rs. " followed by the amount, e.g. "Rs. 500"
acceptanceCriteria.text: Catalogue is available through the API: GET /api/productsList lists the products of the catalogue in a "products" array; every product has an "id", a "name", a "price", a "brand" and a "category"; the category holds the audience ("usertype", e.g. Women, Men, Kids) and the category name; every price is written as "Rs. " followed by the amount, e.g. "Rs. 500".
outcomes: the response lists the catalogue products in a "products" array
every product has an "id", a "name", a "price", a "brand" and a "category"
every category holds the audience ("usertype", e.g. Women, Men, Kids) and the category name
every price is "Rs. " followed by the amount (e.g. "Rs. 500")

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-2 Search by a term through the API When a client posts search_product = "jean" to /api/searchProduct Then exactly these products are returned: "Soft Stretch Jeans", "Regular Fit Straight Jeans", "Grunt Blue Slim Fit Jeans"
acceptanceCriteria.text: Search by a term through the API: posting search_product = "jean" to /api/searchProduct returns exactly "Soft Stretch Jeans", "Regular Fit Straight Jeans", "Grunt Blue Slim Fit Jeans".
outcomes: exactly these products are returned: "Soft Stretch Jeans", "Regular Fit Straight Jeans", "Grunt Blue Slim Fit Jeans"
no other product is returned

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-3 Search ignores letter case When a client searches for "TOP" and for "top" Then both searches return the same products
acceptanceCriteria.text: Search ignores letter case: searching for "TOP" and for "top" returns the same products.
outcomes: searching "TOP" and searching "top" return the same products

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-4 Search matches product names When a client searches for "dress" Then every product returned has the term in its product name And every catalogue product whose name contains "dress" is returned
acceptanceCriteria.text: Search matches product names, as replaced by the Product Owner's clarification (G1): searching "dress" returns every product whose name contains "dress" plus every product in a "Dress" category, and nothing else; the brand is not a search field.
outcomes: every product returned for "dress" has "dress" in its product name or its category name (contains match, case-insensitive)
every catalogue product whose name contains "dress" is returned
every catalogue product in a "Dress" category is returned, even without the word in its name (e.g. "Sleeves Top and Short - Blue & Pink", Kids > Dress)
nothing else comes back
searching "Polo" only finds products with "Polo" in the name or category (the brand is not matched)

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-5 Nothing matches When a client searches for "zzqxv" Then an empty product list is returned, not an error
acceptanceCriteria.text: Nothing matches: searching for "zzqxv" returns an empty product list, not an error.
outcomes: searching "zzqxv" returns an empty product list
the response is not an error

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-6 Search without a term (empty value) When a client posts search_product with an empty value Then the whole catalogue is returned, the same products as GET /api/productsList
acceptanceCriteria.text: Search without a term (empty value): posting search_product with an empty value returns the whole catalogue, the same products as GET /api/productsList.
outcomes: posting search_product with an empty value returns the whole catalogue
the products returned are the same products as GET /api/productsList

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-7 Search without a term (parameter missing) When a client posts to /api/searchProduct without the search_product parameter Then the request is rejected with response code 400 And the message is "Bad request, search_product parameter is missing in POST request."
acceptanceCriteria.text: Search without a term (parameter missing): posting to /api/searchProduct without the search_product parameter is rejected with response code 400 and the message "Bad request, search_product parameter is missing in POST request."
outcomes: the request is rejected with response code 400
message "Bad request, search_product parameter is missing in POST request."

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-8 Search from the Products page Given a shopper on the Products page When they type "jean" in the search box and press the search button Then the product grid is headed "Searched Products" And the search box still shows "jean" And exactly the three jeans products listed in AC-2 are shown
acceptanceCriteria.text: Search from the Products page: typing "jean" in the search box and pressing the search button shows the product grid headed "Searched Products", the search box still shows "jean", and exactly the three jeans products listed in AC-2 are shown.
outcomes: the product grid is headed "Searched Products"
the search box still shows "jean"
exactly "Soft Stretch Jeans", "Regular Fit Straight Jeans", "Grunt Blue Slim Fit Jeans" are shown

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-9 Searching from the Products page without a term Given a shopper on the Products page When they leave the search box empty and press the search button Then the grid is headed "All Products" And every product of the catalogue (GET /api/productsList) is shown
acceptanceCriteria.text: Searching from the Products page without a term: leaving the search box empty and pressing the search button shows the grid headed "All Products" with every product of the catalogue (GET /api/productsList).
outcomes: the grid is headed "All Products"
every product of the catalogue (GET /api/productsList) is shown

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario Outline: AC-10 The shop and the API agree on search results When a shopper searches for "<term>" on the Products page Then the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "<term>" Examples: | term | | top | | dress | | Men Tshirt |
acceptanceCriteria.text: The shop and the API agree on search results: for each term (top, dress, Men Tshirt), the products shown on the Products page are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for that term.
outcomes: for "top", the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "top"
for "dress", the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "dress"
for "Men Tshirt", the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "Men Tshirt"

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Scenario: AC-11 No results on the Products page When a shopper searches for "zzqxv" on the Products page Then the grid is headed "Searched Products" and no product is shown
acceptanceCriteria.text: No results on the Products page: searching for "zzqxv" shows the grid headed "Searched Products" and no product.
outcomes: the grid is headed "Searched Products"
no product is shown

endpoints.request: Same host as the shop; form-encoded requests (L24). Returns the whole catalogue in a "products" array (L37). Described as a public product API (L17).
Form-encoded (L24), parameter search_product holding the search term (L26). Returns the products matching the term. Described as a public product API (L17).

rules.text: Search matches the product name or its category name (the category under Women / Men / Kids, e.g. "Dress", "Tops", "Tops & Shirts", "Tshirts"). Searching "dress" returns every product whose name contains "dress" plus every product in a "Dress" category; nothing else comes back.
The brand is not a search field: searching "Polo" only finds products with "Polo" in the name or category.
Matching is a "contains" match, case-insensitive, as in AC-3.
Search terms are plain words or phrases, for example jean, top, dress, Men Tshirt.

errorModel.body: Bad request, search_product parameter is missing in POST request.

testData.strategy: None created: the story reads the existing catalogue (GET /api/productsList, the Products page); AC-2, AC-4 and AC-8 name products that already exist in the catalogue.

outOfScope: punctuation and special characters in search terms (tracked separately) (story.md#L28)
browsing by brand, which is AE-3 (story.md#L103)
